app.Response.description: The Response struct is used for wrapping the API response with a code, message, and data.

code.description:
Code is the HTTP status code or a custom code used to indicate the result of the request
@example 200

data.description:
Data is the response data (can be any object or null)
@example {"id": 1, "name": "John Doe"}

msg.description:
Msg is the message that describes the result of the request
@example "Request successful"

availability.description: Stock status shown on the listing, such as `In Stock`.

condition.description: Item condition as listed, such as `Pre-Owned`.

item_feedback_count.description: Number of buyer feedback entries for this item.

item_id.description: eBay item ID of the listing. Use it with the item endpoint.

item_specifics.description: Item specifics table of the listing, mapping each label to its value.

link.description: URL of the listing on eBay.

location.description: Item location shown on the listing, such as `Canada`.

price.description: Item price as a number, in the listing's currency.

price_text.description: Price as shown on the listing, such as `US $49.95`.

sale_status.description: Approximate converted price or bid count shown on the listing, when present.

seller_categories.description: Names of the categories in the seller's store.

seller_description.description: Seller's own description of their store.

seller_detailed_ratings.description: Seller's detailed ratings, mapping each criterion such as `Communication` to its average score.

seller_followers.description: Number of eBay users following the seller.

seller_items_sold.description: Number of items the seller has sold.

seller_link.description: URL of the seller's eBay profile.

seller_logo_url.description: URL of the seller's store logo.

seller_member_since.description: When the seller joined eBay, such as `Mar 1998`.

seller_positive_feedback.description: Share of the seller's feedback that is positive, as a percentage.

seller_store_name.description: Name of the seller's eBay store.

seller_total_feedback_count.description: Total number of feedback entries the seller has received.

shipping.description: Shipping cost as shown on the listing, such as `+$4.95 shipping`.

title.description: Listing title as shown on the item page.
title.example: 1983 TOPPS BASEBALL - 1952 TOPPS REPRINTS #311 MICKEY MANTLE

description.example: Brand NEW & Open Box Milwaukee tools, batteries, and bundles!

title.example: Jules' Tools - Milwaukee, DeWALT, Ryobi Power TOOLS!!!

concurrent_viewer_count.description:
ConcurrentViewerCount is the live viewer count at the time of the
request. Zero for streams that are not currently LIVE.

description.example: Brand NEW & Open Box Milwaukee tools, batteries, and bundles!

title.example: Jules' Tools - Milwaukee, DeWALT, Ryobi Power TOOLS!!!

feedback_positive_count.description:
Feedback* / *Rating fields are only populated by Service.GetLiveStream
(single-stream detail); Service.ListLiveStreams' hub feed does not
request this data, so these are zero/omitted there. All scores are
scoped to the seller's last 365 days of feedback.

auction_status.description:
Auction* fields reflect the live bidding state and are only meaningful
for saleType Auction. AuctionStatus is one of READY (queued, not yet
started), LIVE (actively taking bids), or ENDED.

is_exclusive.description:
IsExclusive/Purchasable reflect eBay Live's own commerce-signal flags
for this listing (e.g. whether it can be bought outright vs. only won
via the live auction).

title.example: #001 - Tool ONLY - Unless Specified! - Watch Auction

streams.description:
Streams preserves the order returned by upstream, which is not
guaranteed to match the requested id order. An id that does not
resolve to a real event is silently omitted -- confirmed live that
upstream returns 200 with a shorter events array rather than an error
for unknown ids, matching the plural-lookup semantics of a batch
endpoint rather than the single-id GetLiveStream's typed 404.

next_request_number.description:
NextRequestNumber and SessionID feed back into a follow-up call's
request_number/session_id to fetch the next page.

bid_count.description: Number of bids on an auction listing.

caption.description: Caption line shown on the search card.

image.description: URL of the listing's thumbnail image.

is_authenticity_guaranteed.description: Whether the listing carries eBay's Authenticity Guarantee.

item_id.description: eBay item ID of the listing. Use it with the item endpoint.

link.description: URL of the listing on eBay.

location.description: Item location shown on the search card, such as `Canada`.

logistic.description: Shipping information shown on the search card, such as `+$4.95 shipping`.

info.description: Crawlora is a hosted web-data and SERP API: call documented REST endpoints and get normalized JSON instead of HTML to parse — across search/SERP, maps and local, e-commerce, app stores, social, media and finance. One API key; Crawlora runs the proxy rotation, headless browsers and parsing behind the scenes. Billed pay-on-success: charged only on a successful 2xx response, 1-10 credits per call, with a free tier of 2,000 credits per month and no card. A hosted MCP server (mcp.crawlora.net/mcp) exposes the same catalog as agent tools. Search endpoints accept `q` as a universal alias for whichever search-term parameter they document (`query`, `term`, `keyword`, or Amazon's `k`), so one parameter name works across the whole catalog; an explicitly supplied documented name always wins.
info.title: Crawlora API

get.description: Returns the details of one eBay listing by `item_id`: title, link, images, price and price text, condition, availability, item specifics, description, location and shipping. It also carries the seller's name, store, feedback score, followers and items sold, along with the listing's rating and rating count.

Lists live and upcoming eBay Live streams for one category channel, set with `category` (default `explore`; other values are channel ids such as `IPqZx79LNuwFcSVt` for Sports Singles). Each stream has its title, state, start time, watch count, hosts, tags and preview media. Host feedback is not included. Page on with `next_request_number` and `session_id`, passed back as `request_number` and `session_id`.

parameters.description: eBay Live category channel, defaults to explore
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's next_request_number, defaults to 0
parameters.name: request_number

parameters.description: Pagination session id from a previous response's session_id
parameters.name: session_id

get.description: Returns summaries for several eBay Live streams in one call. `ids` is required and takes up to 9 stream ids, comma-separated or repeated. Each stream has its title, state, watch count, hosts, tags and preview media, without the per-host feedback summary. Ids that do not resolve are silently omitted, and the order may differ from the request.

parameters.description: One or more eBay Live stream/event ids, up to 9. Comma-separated or repeated query values are both accepted.
parameters.name: ids

get.description: Returns one eBay Live stream or event by `id`, taken from the `streams[].id` of the stream list. The response has title, description, state, start and end times, viewer, watch and like counts, tags, channels and the live, preview and replay URLs. Each host carries a 365-day feedback summary and four average ratings. An unknown id returns `404`.

Lists the items currently featured in an eBay Live stream, identified by the required event `id`. Each item has its listing id, title, price and currency, bid count, sale type, leader and winner usernames, and `auction_status` (`READY`, `LIVE` or `ENDED`). A stream with no featured items, or an unknown id, returns an empty `items` array.
get.summary: List an eBay Live stream's featured items

post.description: Searches eBay listings by keyword from a JSON body, with page, page size (60, 120 or 240) and a listing-status filter (`active`, `sold`, `completed` or `sold_completed`). Each result has the item id, title, link, image, price or price range, bid count, seller and rating, location, shipping information, and sold and watcher counts.

get.description: Returns the public profile of an eBay seller by the required `seller` username: display name, store name and URL, profile URL, description, location, member-since date, positive feedback percentage, feedback count, items sold, followers, and detailed seller ratings. Feedback details are included when eBay provides them.
Returns seller about information from the eBay store about tab, including seller stats, top-rated status, optional location/member-since fields, and cleaned store categories.

Returns the feedback eBay shows for a seller, identified by the required `seller` username. The response has the total feedback count, positive feedback percentage, overall rating summary, detailed seller ratings, and review cards with buyer, comment, rating, period and verified-purchase flag. Page with `page` (default 1) and `per_page` (24, 48 or 72; default 48), using `has_more` and `next_page`.

Lists the items in an eBay seller's shop, identified by the required `seller` username, one page at a time with `page` (default 1). Each result has its item id, title, link, image, price or price range, shipping note, location, bid count and watcher count. The response gives the `total` and a `has_more` flag.
